title: Share font-size scaling between board and Git history
body: board.rs and git_history.rs each hand-multiply every px value by font_size / DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE (the git_history version came from card 06zk79). Any new size without the factor won't zoom, and no test catches that. Pull the scaling into one shared helper, e.g. a scaled-style wrapper, so new UI zooms by default. Low priority: do it when a third view needs zoom. Start in a fresh session.
